description:
Turn the current logical baselines and profiles into a bounded portfolio for the XOR unroll and consumer-specific dispatch experiments before candidate samples are collected.

## Background

The portfolio names a finite unroll-factor family and at most one measured unhoisted consumer with a materially different call contract. It keeps the 64-word generic-hoist no-win and already-hoisted algorithm loops out of the search. ISA-L remains an external comparison under its qualified symbol and adapter contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The portfolio names each exact logical candidate, target cells, rationale from current profiles, implementation complexity budget, comparison family, and stop condition before candidate measurement.
- [hard] REQ-02: A missing profile signal is recorded as a no-candidate outcome rather than replaced with an unmeasured optimization, and the preserved generic-hoist no-win remains excluded.
- [hard] REQ-03: Candidate scopes use the canonical logical-buffer and dispatch authority without pre-authorizing a production change.

## Notes

This is an experimental selection contract, not a production adoption decision.
title: Freeze the logical candidate portfolio
